gloss: to step into; to set foot in

definitions.gloss: to step into; to set foot in
definitions.explanation: To put one's foot into a place, or, figuratively, to enter a field or world. Almost always with {足|あし}を.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I set foot in Tokyo for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れたら⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}せない→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いていた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧だった。
examples.english: I had heard it was a world you can't get out of once you set foot in it, and it was true.

notes:
USAGE:
- Literal (entering a place) or figurative (entering a field): ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れる (to go into politics).
- Often cautious or negative: ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れて⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (a place one must not enter).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive (⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧); the place takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{踏|ふ}み{込|こ}む→踏み込む：06972_fumikomu⟧: to step in boldly; also to go deeper into a subject
